intent: A portfolio case-study header: huge title with a serif-italic emphasis, a meta grid, a big cover of CSS-drawn laptop and phone mockups on a bold colour field, and three result stats.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries, cqw units)
stack.fonts: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque), font-serif (Instrument Serif), font-sans (Geist), font-mono (Geist Mono)

rows: results: mono heading + 3 stat columns with 2px top rules

cover.laptop: lg: 64% wide, left 11%, top 11%; mobile: 118% wide, bleeding right
cover.phone: lg: 17% wide, right 12%, bottom 7%, rotate 5deg; mobile 37%
cover.backdrop: yolk circle off the top-right, 22px dot grid at 14%, mono caption top-left (sm+)

motion.header: eyebrow, title, meta rise 12-24px + fade, 0.8s ease [0.2,0.8,0.2,1], staggered 0-140ms
motion.cover: figure rises 40px at 200ms; laptop y 8% -> 0 at 350ms; phone y 18% -> 0 and rotate 0 -> 5deg at 500ms

responsive.mobile: title ~48px; meta 2 cols; square cover with the laptop bleeding off the right behind the phone; stats stack
responsive.lg: 16/9 cover; intro and meta side by side; title up to 140px

accessibility: figure with sr-only figcaption; mockups aria-hidden
visible focus on the back link
AA contrast for all real text

content.title: The weekly shop, done in four minutes.
stats: 31% less food binned across 2,400 pilot households
content.screens: laptop: weekly meal planner with ingredients, spend chart and basket; phone: basket checklist, slot and checkout
